name: A Distant Bell
description: Somewhere beyond the hills, a bell rings three times. There is no village in sight.

name: The Wandering Crow
description: A crow lands on a nearby fence, looks directly at you, and lets out a single loud caw before flying away.

name: Sudden Rain
description: A brief shower begins without warning. Within a few minutes, the clouds disappear and the road is dry again.

name: The Empty Wagon
description: An old wooden wagon rolls slowly down the road by itself. It eventually disappears around a bend.

name: Strange Footprints
description: You notice a set of unfamiliar footprints crossing the path. They stop abruptly in the middle of the road.

name: A Laugh in the Distance
description: You hear someone laughing somewhere far away. When you look around, there is nobody there.

name: Falling Leaves
description: A sudden gust of wind sends a spiral of golden leaves dancing across the ground.

name: The Old Man
description: An old traveler walks past you without saying a word. After a few steps, he turns around, smiles, and continues on his way.

name: A Howling Dog
description: Somewhere nearby, a dog begins howling. Another dog answers from much farther away.

name: The Flickering Light
description: A faint light appears between the trees in the distance. It flickers several times before vanishing.

name: A Broken Signpost
description: You pass an old signpost. One of its arrows slowly creaks in the wind, pointing toward nowhere in particular.

name: The Fox
description: A red fox crosses the road ahead of you. It pauses for a moment, glances back, and disappears into the bushes.

name: Distant Thunder
description: Thunder rumbles across the horizon, although the sky above you remains perfectly clear.

name: The Silent Rider
description: A rider on a dark horse passes by without a word. Neither the rider nor the horse makes much noise as they disappear into the distance.

name: A Strange Smell
description: For a moment, the air smells strongly of smoke and pine. A few seconds later, the scent is completely gone.

name: The Dancing Grass
description: A small patch of grass bends and sways despite the fact that the surrounding air is perfectly still.

name: A Child's Song
description: You hear a child singing somewhere nearby. The song stops suddenly when you turn toward the sound.

name: The Falling Star
description: A bright star streaks across the night sky, vanishing beyond the horizon.

name: The Traveling Merchant
description: A merchant passes you on the road, muttering to himself about the weather. He never notices you.

name: The Empty Campfire
description: You come across a campfire that is still warm, but there is nobody around it.

name: A Moment of Silence
description: For several seconds, every sound around you disappears. Then the world suddenly becomes noisy again.

name: The Curious Deer
description: A deer watches you from between the trees. After a few moments, it calmly turns around and walks away.

name: The Distant Horn
description: A deep horn sounds somewhere beyond the mountains. No second horn follows.

name: A Door in the Woods
description: Between two trees stands an old wooden door with no visible building around it. It is slightly open.

name: The Sudden Fog
description: A thin layer of fog drifts across the road, surrounding you for a few moments before slowly fading away.

name: The Singing Wind
description: The wind passes through a narrow gap in the rocks, producing a sound strangely similar to a human whistle.

name: A Forgotten Statue
description: You pass a weathered stone statue half-covered in moss. Its face has been worn away by time.

name: The Running Rabbit
description: A rabbit suddenly races across your path at full speed, as if being chased by something you cannot see.

name: A Distant Argument
description: Two voices can be heard arguing somewhere far away. Their words are impossible to make out.

name: The Unusual Moon
description: For just a moment, a thin cloud passes over the moon, making it appear strangely enormous before the illusion disappears.
